scripts.install: cd backend && npm i && cd ../admin-frontend && npm i
scripts.dev: docker compose -f ./docker/docker-compose.yml up -d && docker image prune -f && npm run dev:watch
scripts.dev-rebuild: docker compose -f ./docker/docker-compose.yml up -d --build && docker image prune -f && npm run dev:watch
scripts.backend:dev: docker compose -f ./docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm admin-frontend npm install && docker compose -f ./docker/docker-compose.yml up -d --build && docker image prune -f
scripts.backend: docker compose --env-file ./config/environment-variables/.env.docker.prod -f ./docker/docker-compose.prod.yml up -d && docker image prune
scripts.seed: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy && npx prisma db seed
scripts.seed:dev: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy && npm run db:seed:dev
